name: get_world_record
description: Fetches details for a world record, which may include the record holder's name, the nature of the record, the date it was set, and any other relevant information or statistics.

required_parameters.name: record_category
required_parameters.description: The category of the world record. Examples include 'tallest man', 'fastest swimmer in Olympics', 'oldest person', etc.

result_parameters.name: record_holder
result_parameters.description: The name of the person or entity who holds the record.

result_parameters.name: record_detail
result_parameters.description: Details about the record. Can include height, speed, age, etc., depending on the type of record.

result_parameters.name: record_holder_status
result_parameters.description: The status of the record holder. For example, whether they are currently alive or not.

result_parameters.name: record_date
result_parameters.description: The date the record was set.

result_parameters.name: record_location
result_parameters.description: The location (nationality or residence) associated with the record holder.
